! JO9 MOD START PRIVATE_ROOM_CAP_LOOKUP | 2026-10-19_private_room_residence_caps
result = 0
if $lcase($estate) = 'kamira_house' or $lcase($estate) = 'otchuzhdenie_house': result = 1
if $lcase($estate) = 'serpis_house' or $lcase($estate) = 'redlight_house': result = 2
if $lcase($estate) = 'taurus_house' or $lcase($estate) = 'korvus_house': result = 3
if $lcase($estate) = 'white_house' or $lcase($estate) = 'centralkvartal_house': result = 4
! JO9 MOD END PRIVATE_ROOM_CAP_LOOKUP
